about: Semantic overlap review of the four Connections boards Audit Batch A changed (owner direction 2026-11-07: keep the uniqueness solver, and also review overlaps its declared relationships may not capture). Every tile is listed. 'alsoFits' names any OTHER group on the same board a reasonable player might put the tile in, including weak associations; 'note' says why. tests/batch-a-compat.test.ts re-runs the solver with every listed fit plus the declared overlaps in audit-verdicts.json and requires exactly one solution. Reviewer: Claude (AI editorial pass), not a human review.

Frost.note: 'Jack Frost' is a character; there is no characters group.

Blizzard.note: Weak: a branded ice-cream dessert. Not Christmas food, but listed to stress the board.

Sleet.note: The A1 replacement: a weather condition with no other reading on this board.

Dasher.note: Donner and Blitzen (German for thunder and lightning) would overlap with weather; they are deliberately not on the board.

Vixen.note: A female fox; no animals group.

Sparrow.note: A2 replacement for Owl (not a typical garden bird).

Blackbird.note: A2 replacement for Swan (not a garden bird).

Egg.note: Laid by farm birds, but an egg is not an animal or a bird.

Snail.note: A garden creature, but the group is garden BIRDS.

Turtle.note: An animal, not a farm one (declared); weak bird pull from 'turtle dove'.

Pearl.note: An organic gem (the A3 label 'Gems' covers it).

Amber.note: Weak: fossilised tree resin. An organic gem.

Cherry.note: A shade of red, not green.

Plum.note: A shade of purple, not green.

Lemon.note: A shade of yellow, not green.

Lime.note: Declared. Counting forces it to the fruits.

Basil.note: Judged NOT a shade of green: 'basil green' exists only as a paint or fashion name. If an editor disagrees, the board has two solutions (Basil and Sage could swap between herbs and greens), so the editor should confirm this call (tests/batch-a-compat.test.ts).

Jade.note: Also a houseplant, but not a herb.

Sage.note: Declared. Counting forces it to the greens, because the herbs are full without it.

acrossBoards.con-s4-12: Seven tiles are also girls' names (Ruby, Pearl, Amber, Opal, Rose, Daisy, Lily). There is no names group, and seven is more than four, so it is misdirection, not a second solution.
acrossBoards.con-s4-02: Basil and Rosemary are also names; no names group.
